## Fixes

- **RPG Maker VX Ace**: in games whose save menu shows the party and gold on the load screen, edits went to that preview copy instead of the real save data. The game ignored them and replaced them the next time it saved. Edits now go to the data the game actually loads (#76)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/truongthang2211/RPGSaveEditor/compare/v1.7.1...v1.7.2
